description.en:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks to deal Spectro DMG.
After performing Basic Attack Stage 3, press Normal Attack at the right time to perform Basic Attack Breakthrough, which can be followed by Basic Attack Stage 4 by pressing Normal Attack again.

Heavy Attack

Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG. Press Normal Attack within a certain time to perform Basic Attack Stage 3.

Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform a plunging attack, dealing Spectro DMG. Press Normal Attack within a certain time to perform Basic Attack Stage 3.

Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack within a certain time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG. Then press Normal Attack at the right time to cast Basic Attack Breakthrough.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Spectro DMG.
Setelah melakukan Basic Attack Tahap 3, tekan Normal Attack pada waktu yang tepat untuk melakukan Basic Attack Breakthrough, yang dapat dilanjutkan dengan Basic Attack Tahap 4 dengan menekan Normal Attack lagi.

Heavy Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target, memberikan Spectro DMG. Tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu tertentu untuk melakukan Basic Attack Tahap 3.

Mid-air Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, memberikan Spectro DMG. Tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu tertentu untuk melakukan Basic Attack Tahap 3.

Dodge Counter

Tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu tertentu setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Spectro DMG. Lalu tekan Normal Attack pada waktu yang tepat untuk melancarkan Basic Attack Breakthrough.

description.en:
Standard Defense Protocol

Attack the target to deal Spectro DMG and enter a block stance. This state ends early if Zani is switched off the field. Press Normal Attack within a certain time to perform Basic Attack Stage 3, recovering 10 points of Redundant Energy and Stagnating the target on hit.
When attacked by an enemy while in block stance, reduce this instance of damage by 100% and Stagnate nearby targets, then cast Pinpoint Strike, dealing Spectro DMG and further reducing their Vibration Strength by 5%. DMG taken by Zani is reduced by 30% within the next 2s.

Crisis Response Protocol

When Zani is not in Inferno Mode and has full Redundant Energy, her Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill Crisis Response Protocol.
Hold Resonance Skill to enter Ready Stance. While in Ready Stance, Zani is immune to interruption. This state ends early if Zani is switched off the field. After releasing Resonance Skill button or when the stance duration ends, consume all Redundant Energy to cast Targeted Action, dealing Spectro DMG, which is also considered Spectro Frazzle DMG.
When attacked by an enemy in while in Ready Stance, reduce this instance of damage by 100% and consume all Redundant Energy to cast Forcible Riposte, dealing Spectro DMG (also considered Spectro Frazzle DMG), Stagnating the target, and further reducing their Vibration Strength by 5%. DMG taken by Zani is reduced by 30% within the next 2s.
Casting Targeted Action or Forcible Riposte sends Zani into Sunburst mode and inflicts a stack of Heliacal Ember upon the target on hit. The last stage of the attack recovers Blaze.

Sunburst

The Spectro Frazzle DMG dealt by Zani to the target is Amplified by 20%.
description.id:
Standard Defense Protocol

Menyerang target untuk memberikan Spectro DMG dan memasuki sikap bertahan. Status ini berakhir lebih awal jika Zani diganti keluar dari arena. Tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu tertentu untuk melakukan Basic Attack Tahap 3, memulihkan 10 poin Redundant Energy dan menimbulkan Stagnate pada target saat mengenai target.
Saat diserang musuh dalam sikap bertahan, kurangi damage serangan ini sebesar 100% dan timbulkan Stagnate pada target di sekitar, lalu lancarkan Pinpoint Strike, memberikan Spectro DMG dan mengurangi Vibration Strength mereka lebih lanjut sebesar 5%. DMG yang diterima Zani berkurang sebesar 30% dalam 2 dtk berikutnya.

Crisis Response Protocol

Saat Zani tidak berada dalam Inferno Mode dan Redundant Energy penuh, Resonance Skill-nya digantikan oleh Resonance Skill Crisis Response Protocol.
Tahan Resonance Skill untuk memasuki Ready Stance. Saat dalam Ready Stance, Zani kebal terhadap interupsi. Status ini berakhir lebih awal jika Zani diganti keluar dari arena. Setelah tombol Resonance Skill dilepas atau saat durasi sikap berakhir, konsumsi seluruh Redundant Energy untuk melancarkan Targeted Action, memberikan Spectro DMG, yang juga dianggap sebagai Spectro Frazzle DMG.
Saat diserang musuh dalam Ready Stance, kurangi damage serangan ini sebesar 100% dan konsumsi seluruh Redundant Energy untuk melancarkan Forcible Riposte, memberikan Spectro DMG (juga dianggap sebagai Spectro Frazzle DMG), menimbulkan Stagnate pada target, dan mengurangi Vibration Strength mereka lebih lanjut sebesar 5%. DMG yang diterima Zani berkurang sebesar 30% dalam 2 dtk berikutnya.
Melancarkan Targeted Action atau Forcible Riposte membuat Zani memasuki mode Sunburst dan menimbulkan satu stack Heliacal Ember pada target saat mengenai target. Tahap terakhir serangan memulihkan Blaze.

Sunburst

Spectro Frazzle DMG yang diberikan Zani kepada target di-Amplify sebesar 20%.

description.en:
Rekindle

Deal Spectro DMG and enter Inferno Mode, increasing Max Blaze from 100 to 150 and granting 50 Blazes. When in Inferno Mode, the DMG Multiplier of Basic Attack is increased.

The Last Stand

When in Inferno Mode, Resonance Liberation The Last Stand becomes available when Blaze is lower than 30 or after 8s in Inferno Mode.
Casting Resonance Liberation The Last Stand deals Spectro DMG and ends the Inferno Mode.
description.id:
Rekindle

Memberikan Spectro DMG dan memasuki Inferno Mode, meningkatkan Max Blaze dari 100 menjadi 150 dan memberikan 50 Blaze. Saat dalam Inferno Mode, Pengali DMG Basic Attack meningkat.

The Last Stand

Saat dalam Inferno Mode, Resonance Liberation The Last Stand tersedia ketika Blaze kurang dari 30 atau setelah 8 dtk dalam Inferno Mode.
Melancarkan Resonance Liberation The Last Stand memberikan Spectro DMG dan mengakhiri Inferno Mode.

description.en: Casting Intro Skill Immediate Execution gives 12% Spectro DMG Bonus for 14s.
description.id: Melancarkan Intro Skill Immediate Execution memberikan 12% Spectro DMG Bonus selama 14 dtk.

description.en: When in Ready Stance, all DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
description.id: Saat dalam Ready Stance, semua DMG yang diterima berkurang sebesar 40%.

description.en: Attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.

Heliacal Ember

When Zani is in the team and a nearby Resonator inflicts Spectro Frazzle upon a target, immediately trigger the DMG of all Spectro Frazzle stacks and convert Spectro Frazzle into an equal number of Heliacal Embers. Every time the conversion happens, Zani obtains Blaze based on the stacks of Heliacal Ember inflicted. Heliacal Ember is capped at 60 stacks, with each stack lasting for 6s. Heliacal Ember stacks are counted toward the Spectro Frazzle stacks for the Eternal Radiance Sonata Effect.

Scorching Light

When Zani is in Inferno Mode, Heavy Slash - Daybreak, Heavy Slash - Dawning, Heavy Slash - Nightfall, and Heavy Slash - Lightsmash become available, which deal Spectro DMG that is considered both Heavy Attack DMG and Spectro Frazzle DMG.
When Blaze is no less than 30, Resonance Skill Standard Defense Protocol is replaced with Resonance Skill Scorching Light.
Hold Resonance Skill to enter Ready Stance, during which Zani is immune to interruption. This state ends early when Zani is switched off the field. While in Ready Stance, release Resonance Skill button within a certain time to consume Blaze and perform Heavy Slash - Daybreak.
When attacked in a certain time after entering Ready Stance, reduce this instance of damage by 100% and Stagnate nearby targets, then perform Heavy Slash - Lightsmash, consuming Blazes and further reducing their Vibration Strength by 10%. Zani's DMG taken within the next 2s is reduced by 30%.
After casting Heavy Slash - Lightsmash, Basic Attack is replaced with Heavy Slash - Nightfall, consuming up to 40 Blazes on hit, with each Blaze increasing the DMG Multiplier of Heavy Slash - Nightfall. If Heavy Slash - Nightfall Stage 1 is interrupted, press Basic Attack again to cast Heavy Slash - Nightfall Stage 2.
Upon releasing the button after a certain time or when Ready Stance ends, immediately perform Heavy Slash - Nightfall.
When Blaze is no less than 30, Basic Attack is replaced with Heavy Slash - Daybreak. After entering Inferno Mode, casting Basic Attack immediately replaces the current Basic Attack with Resonance Skill Scorching Light. Hold Basic Attack to enter Ready Stance.
After performing Heavy Slash - Daybreak, press Basic Attack immediately to perform Heavy Slash - Dawning at the cost of Blaze.
After performing Heavy Slash - Dawning, Basic Attack is replaced with Heavy Slash - Nightfall.
If Basic Attack is not replaced with Heavy Slash - Nightfall after a successful Dodge and Zani has no less than 30 Blazes, press Normal Attack within a certain time to perform Heavy Slash - Lightsmash at the cost of Blazes.

Redundant Energy

Zani can hold up to 100 Redundant Energy.
Obtain Redundant Energy when Normal Attacks hit a target.
Obtain Redundant Energy when casting Intro Skill Immediate Execution.
Obtain Redundant Energy when casting Resonance Skill Standard Defense Protocol.
Obtain Redundant Energy when casting Pinpoint Strike.
Cannot obtain Redundant Energy while in Inferno Mode.

Blaze

Blaze is capped at 100 when not in Inferno Mode.
Blaze is capped at 150 in Inferno Mode.
Casting Targeted Action or Forcible Riposte grants 10 Blazes.
Every stack of Heliacal Ember converted from Spectro Frazzle grants 5 Blazes.
Casting Resonance Liberation Rekindle grants 50 Blazes.
description.id:
Heliacal Ember

Saat Zani berada di tim dan Resonator di sekitar menimbulkan Spectro Frazzle pada target, seketika memicu DMG seluruh stack Spectro Frazzle dan mengubah Spectro Frazzle menjadi Heliacal Ember dalam jumlah yang sama. Setiap kali konversi terjadi, Zani mendapat Blaze berdasarkan stack Heliacal Ember yang ditimbulkan. Heliacal Ember dibatasi hingga 60 stack, dengan setiap stack berlangsung selama 6 dtk. Stack Heliacal Ember dihitung sebagai stack Spectro Frazzle untuk Efek Sonata Eternal Radiance.

Scorching Light

Saat Zani berada dalam Inferno Mode, Heavy Slash - Daybreak, Heavy Slash - Dawning, Heavy Slash - Nightfall, dan Heavy Slash - Lightsmash tersedia, yang memberikan Spectro DMG yang dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG sekaligus Spectro Frazzle DMG.
Saat Blaze minimal 30, Resonance Skill Standard Defense Protocol digantikan oleh Resonance Skill Scorching Light.
Tahan Resonance Skill untuk memasuki Ready Stance, yang membuat Zani kebal terhadap interupsi. Status ini berakhir lebih awal saat Zani diganti keluar dari arena. Saat dalam Ready Stance, lepas tombol Resonance Skill dalam waktu tertentu untuk mengonsumsi Blaze dan melakukan Heavy Slash - Daybreak.
Saat diserang dalam waktu tertentu setelah memasuki Ready Stance, kurangi damage serangan ini sebesar 100% dan timbulkan Stagnate pada target di sekitar, lalu lakukan Heavy Slash - Lightsmash, mengonsumsi Blaze dan mengurangi Vibration Strength mereka lebih lanjut sebesar 10%. DMG yang diterima Zani dalam 2 dtk berikutnya berkurang sebesar 30%.
Setelah melancarkan Heavy Slash - Lightsmash, Basic Attack digantikan oleh Heavy Slash - Nightfall, mengonsumsi hingga 40 Blaze saat mengenai target, dengan setiap Blaze meningkatkan Pengali DMG Heavy Slash - Nightfall. Jika Heavy Slash - Nightfall Tahap 1 terinterupsi, tekan Basic Attack lagi untuk melancarkan Heavy Slash - Nightfall Tahap 2.
Saat tombol dilepas setelah waktu tertentu atau saat Ready Stance berakhir, seketika melakukan Heavy Slash - Nightfall.
Saat Blaze minimal 30, Basic Attack digantikan oleh Heavy Slash - Daybreak. Setelah memasuki Inferno Mode, melancarkan Basic Attack seketika mengganti Basic Attack saat ini dengan Resonance Skill Scorching Light. Tahan Basic Attack untuk memasuki Ready Stance.
Setelah melakukan Heavy Slash - Daybreak, tekan Basic Attack segera untuk melakukan Heavy Slash - Dawning dengan biaya Blaze.
Setelah melakukan Heavy Slash - Dawning, Basic Attack digantikan oleh Heavy Slash - Nightfall.
Jika Basic Attack tidak digantikan oleh Heavy Slash - Nightfall setelah Dodge berhasil dan Zani memiliki minimal 30 Blaze, tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu tertentu untuk melakukan Heavy Slash - Lightsmash dengan biaya Blaze.

Redundant Energy

Zani dapat menampung hingga 100 Redundant Energy.
Mendapat Redundant Energy saat Normal Attack mengenai target.
Mendapat Redundant Energy saat melancarkan Intro Skill Immediate Execution.
Mendapat Redundant Energy saat melancarkan Resonance Skill Standard Defense Protocol.
Mendapat Redundant Energy saat melancarkan Pinpoint Strike.
Tidak dapat mendapat Redundant Energy saat dalam Inferno Mode.

Blaze

Blaze dibatasi hingga 100 saat tidak dalam Inferno Mode.
Blaze dibatasi hingga 150 dalam Inferno Mode.
Melancarkan Targeted Action atau Forcible Riposte memberikan 10 Blaze.
Setiap stack Heliacal Ember yang dikonversi dari Spectro Frazzle memberikan 5 Blaze.
Melancarkan Resonance Liberation Rekindle memberikan 50 Blaze.

The DMG Multipliers of Heavy Slash - Daybreak, Heavy Slash- Dawning, Heavy Slash - Nightfall, and Heavy Slash - Lightsmash are increased by 40%. Every Blaze consumed increases the DMG Multiplier of Heavy Slash - Nightfall by 40% on hit.

- Within 8s after entering Inferno Mode, Zani will remain standing with at least 1 HP if hit by a fatal blow.

Pengali DMG Heavy Slash - Daybreak, Heavy Slash- Dawning, Heavy Slash - Nightfall, dan Heavy Slash - Lightsmash meningkat sebesar 40%. Setiap Blaze yang dikonsumsi meningkatkan Pengali DMG Heavy Slash - Nightfall sebesar 40% saat mengenai target.
